title: Version 2.1.145 - Background Session Management and Plugin Enhancements
description: Claude Code v2.1.145 added `claude agents --json` to list live sessions as JSON for scripting, agent telemetry attributes, GitHub repo/PR info in status line, plugin discovery showing commands/agents/skills before installation, and numerous bug fixes for background sessions, Windows PowerShell, MCP servers, and worktree isolation.

community_feedback.author: David Lee (@lordmoma)
community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is excellent at implementation. It is not something I trust unsupervised. Not yet. That distinction matters... Speed is cheap. Correctness is not.

community_feedback.author: Oikon (@oikon48)
community_feedback.quote: Claude Code shipped 176 updates in 2025, demonstrating rapid iteration... Context engineering emerged as the unifying theme across major features. Claude Code is excellent at implementation. It is not something I trust unsupervised.
